label: Two eyes on the edge
about: Three empty points on the top edge. Black plays the middle one, E9, and splits them into two eyes: White can't play in D9 or F9. Had White taken E9 first, Black would have only one eye. White to play; ← steps back.

label: Small two-eye shapes
about: Three black groups, each surrounded by White, each living with two one-point eyes. Top edge: D9 and F9. Bottom left corner: A2 and B1, with A1 and B2 filled in (the A1 stone's only liberties are the two eyes). Bottom right corner: J1 and J3. White can't play in any of the six eyes.
